title: Auriga-SBI
summary: A research repository for simulation-based inference on the Auriga cosmological galaxy simulations, providing data preparation, generative model training, and inference pipelines to infer merger and accretion histories of simulated Milky Way-like galaxies. One training branch (ctgan_ds.py) uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, fit on simulation-derived dataframes via a detected Metadata schema, to generate synthetic tabular data for the SBI training pipeline.
needs: CTGANSynthesizer import present but its instantiation line is commented out; only GaussianCopulaSynthesizer is actually run in the shown code.
